zh-CN.reviewDate: 公开来源核对日期：2026 年 10 月 15 日。阿里前端图为用户提供的历史材料。
zh-CN.intro: 本页整理公司实际公开了什么，不把职级名称一一换算，也不把有限样本概括成国家差异。公开程度并不相同，未找到公开矩阵不代表公司内部没有使用。

chinaCompanies.name: 阿里巴巴
chinaCompanies.theme: 文化、招聘原则、管理者发展与工程实践
chinaCompanies.detail: 公开材料涉及价值观与分层管理者培养。你提供的历史前端图把业务、专业、协作、学习和团队成长放在一张矩阵中，很适合作为历史参考；它不能证明当前集团通用的职级标准。

chinaCompanies.name: 字节跳动
chinaCompanies.theme: 招聘定级原则、文化与新人培养
chinaCompanies.detail: 官方公开页面说明招聘理念和新人培养支持，但没有公开完整的全公司逐阶段能力矩阵。

chinaCompanies.name: 腾讯
chinaCompanies.theme: 价值观与具体岗位招聘要求
chinaCompanies.detail: 公开价值观和招聘岗位可以作为背景材料，但都不能替代完整的内部职级能力框架。

chinaCompanies.name: 百度
chinaCompanies.detail: 公开工程白皮书讨论团队工程实践和标准，不是个人晋升等级定义。

usCompanies.name: Dropbox
usCompanies.theme: 职责、影响与多种高级 IC 贡献形态
usCompanies.detail: 公开工程框架把范围、业务理解、决策、协作和组织健康等纳入要求，并明确提醒不要把框架当成打勾清单。
usCompanies.source: 更新后的工程职业框架

usCompanies.name: GitLab
usCompanies.theme: 公开工程、产品、IC 与管理路径
usCompanies.detail: 不同岗位族的框架把范围、结果以及 IC/管理路径分别写清。产品框架明确包含战略、客户与市场、业务结果。

factors: 业务结果责任及其时间跨度
影响范围：任务、项目、领域、多团队或组织
自主性、问题模糊度与决策权
专业/产品深度与质量责任
通过专业、协作、管理者或组织产生影响的方式
专业贡献路径还是人员管理路径
zh-CN.comparisonCaveat: 不同公司可能用不同称谓和级别承载相似责任。任何映射都只是待核对的假设，必须结合公司、职能、地域和时期。
zh-CN.stageComparisonIntro: 这里按宽范围分组。现有公开材料不足以支撑六阶段逐行换算职称。

stageComparisons.stages: 初级工程师 · 中级工程师
stageComparisons.pattern: 基于本次公开来源，无法可靠对应到跨公司的统一职称。
stageComparisons.scope: 应在具体公司框架中比较自主性、任务/项目范围和结果责任。

stageComparisons.stages: 高级工程师 · 资深工程师
stageComparisons.pattern: 部分公开框架区分 Senior 与 Staff+ IC 责任范围。
stageComparisons.scope: GitLab 公开了 Senior 和 Staff+ 工程能力要求。这是责任模式参考，不等同于本站的两个阶段。

stageComparisons.stages: 工程管理者 · 管理管理者
stageComparisons.pattern: 按团队与多团队责任范围比较管理路径；称谓因公司而异。
stageComparisons.scope: GitLab 公开了独立的管理者发展框架。本次来源不足以支持管理管理者的通用称谓换算。

en.reviewDate: Public sources reviewed October 15, 2026. The Alibaba front-end image is historical material supplied by the user.
en.intro: This comparison summarizes what companies publish. It does not claim a national standard or convert titles one-to-one. Public visibility is uneven, and the sample cannot establish that one country has a single model.

chinaCompanies.name: Alibaba
chinaCompanies.theme: Culture, hiring principles, manager development, and engineering practice
chinaCompanies.detail: Public materials include values and tiered manager development. The supplied historical front-end matrix offers a useful example of business, craft, collaboration, learning, and team growth in one model; it is not evidence of a current group-wide rubric.

chinaCompanies.name: ByteDance
chinaCompanies.theme: Hiring and leveling principles, culture, and onboarding
chinaCompanies.detail: Official public pages describe hiring principles and new-hire growth support, but do not provide a complete company-wide progression matrix.

chinaCompanies.name: Tencent
chinaCompanies.detail: Public values and job postings are useful context, but neither should be mistaken for a full internal leveling framework.

chinaCompanies.name: Baidu
chinaCompanies.detail: The public engineering white paper discusses team engineering practices and standards, rather than individual promotion levels.

usCompanies.name: Dropbox
usCompanies.theme: Responsibilities, impact, and multiple senior IC archetypes
usCompanies.detail: Its public engineering framework connects role expectations to scope, business acumen, decisions, collaboration, and organizational health, and warns against checklist use.

usCompanies.name: GitLab
usCompanies.theme: Published engineering, product, IC, and management paths
usCompanies.detail: Separate job-family frameworks make scope, outcomes, and IC/management paths inspectable. The product framework explicitly covers strategy, customer/market, and outcomes.

factors: Business outcome ownership and time horizon
Scope: task, project, domain, multi-team, or organization
Influence through craft, peers, managers, or organization
en.comparisonCaveat: Similar responsibility patterns can appear under different titles and levels. Treat any mapping as a contextual hypothesis that must be checked against company, function, geography, and time.
en.stageComparisonIntro: This is intentionally a broad grouping. The sources do not support a six-row title conversion.

stageComparisons.pattern: No reliable cross-company title mapping from the sources reviewed.
stageComparisons.scope: Compare autonomy, task/project scope, and outcome ownership in the specific company framework.

stageComparisons.pattern: Some public frameworks distinguish Senior from Staff+ IC scope.
stageComparisons.scope: GitLab publishes senior and Staff+ engineering expectations. These are responsibility patterns, not equivalents to the two stages in this model.

stageComparisons.pattern: Compare the management path by team vs. multi-team responsibility; titles are company-specific.
stageComparisons.scope: GitLab publishes a separate management development framework. The reviewed sources do not support a universal title conversion for the manager-of-managers stage.
